risks.risk: Item may not be a PS4 controller (brand/model/compatibility unknown).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of any brand/model markings on the controller (front/back label) and the exact port/charging connector type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly non-PS4 compatible controller.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: stick drift, worn analogs, unresponsive buttons, trigger problems.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing controller testing: analog stick movement without drift, button presses registering, D-pad and triggers responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly needing repair.

risks.risk: Connectivity/charging uncertainty: wired vs Bluetooth, pairing reliability, battery health, and whether a charging cable is included.
risks.proof: A clip showing pairing/connection on a PS4 (or device) plus a charging test (plug in and show charging indicator/runtime).
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery/charging not guaranteed (worst case: needs cable or may not hold charge).

risks.risk: Seller may be describing a PS4 console + games, but photos show only a controller; mismatch could mean missing items.
risks.proof: Photos of the full bundle: the PS4 console, all 6 games (discs/cases), and any receipt; plus a photo of what exactly is included in the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price only for the controller shown, excluding any unshown console/games.

risks.risk: Clone/compatible controller risk (original vs compatible not readable).
risks.proof: Close-up of the controller label/serial/model and comparison photo of ports/buttons layout; ideally a photo of the packaging/receipt details.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the controller’s brand/model label (front/back) and any serial/model text.
A short test video: analog sticks (no drift), D-pad, face buttons, rear buttons, and triggers working.
Show connectivity: pairing/connection method (wired/Bluetooth) and that it registers correctly on a PS4.
Photo/video of charging: charging port type and whether a charging cable is included; show charging indicator/runtime if rechargeable.
Photos of the full claimed bundle: the PS4 console, all 6 games (discs/cases), and the UK receipt; confirm exactly what is included in the sale.
response.reason: The witness photos confirm only a generic game controller, while the seller claims a hacked PS4 and 6 specific games plus receipt and accessories—none of which are shown or verifiable from the provided images. Without proof of what’s actually included and the controller’s exact compatibility/condition, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
